What is the status of genocide allegatio.question: What is the status of genocide allegations in international legal proceedings (e.g. the ICJ)?
What is the status of genocide allegatio.answer: South Africa brought a case against Israel at the ICJ in December 2023 alleging violation of the Genocide Convention. In January 2024, the ICJ ordered provisional measures requiring Israel to prevent genocide, prevent and punish incitement to genocide, and allow humanitarian aid; it later ordered increased aid and a halt to the Rafah offensive. Israel has not fully complied with these orders. The case appears ongoing, with no final ruling mentioned.
What is the status of genocide allegatio.value: ongoing - provisional measures ordered, no final ruling stated
What is the status of genocide allegatio.evidence: In December 2023, the government of South Africa instituted proceedings, South Africa v. Israel, against Israel at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), alleging a violation of the Genocide Convention. In January 2024, the court ordered Israel to take all measures within its power to prevent the commission of acts of genocide, to prevent and punish incitement to genocide, and to allow basic humanitarian service, aid and supplies into Gaza... The court later ordered Israel to increase humanitarian aid into Gaza and to halt its Rafah offensive. Israel did not fully comply with the court's orders.

What is the status of genocide allegatio.question: What is the status of genocide allegations in international legal proceedings (e.g. the ICJ)?
What is the status of genocide allegatio.answer: South Africa filed a case against Israel at the ICJ alleging violations of the Genocide Convention. In a preliminary ruling, the ICJ found South Africa had standing to bring the case and recognized Palestinians' right to protection from genocide; it ordered Israel to take measures to prevent genocide, punish incitement, and allow humanitarian aid, later ordering increased humanitarian aid and a halt to the Rafah offensive. Israel denies South Africa's claims. Separately, the ICC issued arrest warrants against Netanyahu and Gallant for war crimes and crimes against humanity (not genocide).
